_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.57.1 (named results join on every column they return, from: on a pending result, the no-relation error's join direction); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.78.0 (every canvas action in the bar, the bar follows the selection, naming queries and new queries on the canvas). beamlynx-ui 0.78.0 needs pine-lang 0.57 (its RequiredVersion).
